create_AcceleratedScheduler: create an AcceleratedScheduler wrapping a torch lr_scheduler with optimizers and step_with_optimizer control
step_AcceleratedScheduler: step an AcceleratedScheduler only when optimizer steps succeed, handling gradient accumulation and multi-process scaling
get_last_lr_AcceleratedScheduler: get the last learning rates from an AcceleratedScheduler by delegating to the wrapped scheduler
save_load_AcceleratedScheduler_state: save and load the state of an AcceleratedScheduler using state_dict and load_state_dict passthroughs
get_lr_AcceleratedScheduler: get current learning rates from an AcceleratedScheduler via the get_lr passthrough to the wrapped scheduler
